2527.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.
2527.text1: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

2545.text1: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

2821.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?
2821.text1: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2824.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.
2824.text1: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2825.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.
2825.text1: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

3003.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.
3003.text1: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

3276.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

3341.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.
3341.text1: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

3344.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.
3344.text1: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

3355.text: The warrior's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.
3355.text1: The warrior's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

3382.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?
3382.text1: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

3383.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?
3383.text1: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

3384.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?
3384.text1: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

3385.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.
3385.text1: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

3397.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!
3397.text1: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

3405.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?
3405.text1: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?

3407.text: Where is it ye would like to go $g lad : lass;? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.
3407.text1: Where is it ye would like to go $g lad : lass;? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

3408.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.
3408.text1: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3411.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?
3411.text1: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

3490.text: Tepa is renown for her clothwork.  She can be found at Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.
3490.text1: Tepa is renown for her clothwork.  She can be found at Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.

3901.text: Hello, $n! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3944.text: Welcome to my forge, Blacksmith. Let me share with you a little secret. No one, no one in the world can you trust. Not men, not women, not beasts ... this you can trust, Steel.

3954.text: Everything has a spirit, if you learn to listen to it you can get it to take any shape you want. Blacksmithing isn't about beating metal, forcing it to do your will. It's about listening to the spirit within the steel and guiding it to the shape you know it wants to take.

3987.text1: I don't train smiths with no skill, come back when you have something decent to show me.

4350.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

4615.text1: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

4617.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
4617.text1: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

4618.text: Hello there $g mister : ma'am;... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

4619.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?
4619.text1: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

4621.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?
4621.text1: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

4632.text: Hello, $n! I am master engineer, Scooty.

4670.text: Watch where you're stepping, $c, because I have a polymorph spell with your name on it...

4792.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

4957.text: Welcome to Camp Mojache, brave $c.  How may I assist you this day?

5489.text: The Earth Mother holds many secrets and Brek Stonehoof can help you to discover some of them.  You will find him on the lower rise at Stonehoof Geology.
5489.text1: The Earth Mother holds many secrets and Brek Stonehoof can help you to discover some of them.  You will find him on the lower rise at Stonehoof Geology.

5800.text: There is nothing more that I can teach - now get out! And don't even think of approaching Saru, for one as unworthy as you he will use your blood to temper his steel.

5810.text: You have learned much, but I sense that there is more left for the spirits to teach you. I can place your foot on the path but cannot guide your steps. Go and find Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar, the next stretch of your journey begins there.

5869.text: You go to inner ring of The Apothecarium.  Lavinia Crowe is there.

5886.text: Hmmm, that good idea.  Maybe we head there to get some stitches replaced?  Him sew good.  You find Josef Gregorian on inner circle of Magic Quarter.

5942.text: I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.$B$BHe claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

5943.text: I thank you, $n. Your dedication to my plea gives rest to my lost wife's spirit, and for that I could never repay you enough.$B$BI cannot say that my hatred will ever cease for the quilboar, but it is satiated for now.$B$BNow I must begin to rebuild my life.

6070.text: The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

6075.text: You! $R! Come here. <snort>$B$BTime is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>$B$BMy capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!$B$BThe Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

6077.text: My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.$B$BLong ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>$B$BGreat thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

6117.text: You have <snort> aided Mangletooth more than I would have dreamed, $r.$B$BThank you.$B$BAs long as I remain a captive here, you may bring me blood shards from the Bristleback quilboar and I will bless you with Agamaggan's power.

6767.text: It is Bowen Brisboise that you seek then.  You'll find him inside his house southwest of Brill just on the other side of the bridge at Cold Hearth Manor.
6767.text1: It is Bowen Brisboise that you seek then.  You'll find him inside his house southwest of Brill just on the other side of the bridge at Cold Hearth Manor.

7057.text: The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?
7057.text1: The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?

7156.text: I trust the Light is with you, $n. Is there something that I can I help you with?
7156.text1: I trust the Light is with you, $n. Is there something that I can I help you with?

7164.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $n? Training perhaps?
7164.text1: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $n? Training perhaps?

7196.text: This kodo sure looks nothing like the beast I originally lured!  I wonder if the kombobulator can be used on me.
7196.text1: This kodo sure looks nothing like the beast I originally lured!  I wonder if the kombobulator can be used on me.

7217.text: Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.$B$BIf you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.$B$BBut there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

7226.text: Why is it that small creatures such as goblins are always fascinated with larger creatures?
7226.text1: Why is it that small creatures such as goblins are always fascinated with larger creatures?

7304.text: How do the goblins ever manage to secure packs to these beasts?  Kodos are ten times the size!
7304.text1: How do the goblins ever manage to secure packs to these beasts?  Kodos are ten times the size!

7376.text: $g Hey there cutie, you looking for a ride to Grom'gol? I hear it gets mighty steamy down in those jungles, maybe I could join you for a short vacation, show you a real jungle cat. : Come, take a trip to the wonderful, gorgeous, tropical jungles of Stranglethorn. That's right, you too can be spending your time sunbathing by the crystal blue waters while I stand here in this unbearable heat with nothing to look at but my brother Frezza all day! Enjoy your trip!;
7376.text1: $g Hey there cutie, you looking for a ride to Grom'gol? I hear it gets mighty steamy down in those jungles, maybe I could join you for a short vacation, show you a real jungle cat. : Come, take a trip to the wonderful, gorgeous, tropical jungles of Stranglethorn. That's right, you too can be spending your time sunbathing by the crystal blue waters while I stand here in this unbearable heat with nothing to look at but my brother Frezza all day! Enjoy your trip!;

7377.text: Slip a little coin into the boss's hand and look what it gets ya. I love my job. Though, if I could find a way to get that little firecracker Snurk reassigned to this port....well, I can't imagine it any better. But I'm betting that you aren't here about my business practices. You're looking for the Zeppelin to Undercity, am I right? Well that's great, because it docks right here behind me. Oh and hey, if you see Snurk, put a good word in for me, would ya?
7377.text1: Slip a little coin into the boss's hand and look what it gets ya. I love my job. Though, if I could find a way to get that little firecracker Snurk reassigned to this port....well, I can't imagine it any better. But I'm betting that you aren't here about my business practices. You're looking for the Zeppelin to Undercity, am I right? Well that's great, because it docks right here behind me. Oh and hey, if you see Snurk, put a good word in for me, would ya?

7451.text: Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.$B$BIt never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.
7451.text1: Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.$B$BIt never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

7484.text: Ah... a customer! Talk to my greatest invention, the Vendor-Tron 1000. He has all your needs... some of the rarest items you will ever find on the market anywhere in Kalimdor... not to mention that his programming will not allow any bargaining, so the price you see is the price you pay.

7500.text: My programming will not allow me to lower the cost of any items.

7559.text: Hey mon! You've ever been diving deep in the ocean? I'll let you in on a little secret, eh. Deep in the ocean you can find bubbly fissures; they'll allow you to breathe air while underwater.  Let's keep this secret between you and me though, eh. I don't need no competition for me shellfish traps elsewhere... if you get my drift!

7607.text1: I should find some hired help; I don't like sitting here all day selling fish supplies. I'd much rather go fishing, and then sell supplies.

7614.text: I am Ulysses Rackmore, captain of the Gallant.  And this is the log of the last few days of my doomed ship.$B$BWe were sailing to Feathermoon Stronghold with a shipment of supplies when naga stormed the sides of the Gallant.  We drove them back but we knew they'd return.  Fearing the loss of my most precious belongings, I steered the Gallant to an island off the coast of Desolace, one with old, night elf ruins.  And there I left my treasure chest.

7659.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?
7659.text1: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

7663.text: Da spirits be strong wit you, mon. What kin dis troll do for ya?
7663.text1: Da spirits be strong wit you, mon. What kin dis troll do for ya?

7665.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

7666.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

7706.text: Your capacity for learning has outstripped mine. You will need to talk to Bena Winterhoof over there for further instruction. Please don't take too much of her time, though. She needs her rest.

7707.text1: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

7710.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $n, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

7747.text1: Your potion-making skills are beyond mine. Seek out the undead Doctor Herbert Halsey in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. He has the skill to train you further, and you can witness firsthand his people's plight.

7748.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

7808.text1: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

7829.text: Hmm... well, I can't help you quite yet! You have to learn the basics first. Why don't you go see Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind!

7834.text: You can learn from me in time... but not yet! Why don't you start out by talking to Sprite Jumpsprocket to my right here. You can check in with me after you've gotten your feet wet!

7841.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

7881.text: Eh, well you've made it this far... go see Lavinia Crowe by the other bookshelf there. If you don't mess things up with her, maybe you can learn some more.

7899.text: If you seek to hunt naga, then you will need all the help you can get. Deep in the water you can find bubbly fissures that produce enough air bubbles that will allow you to breath underwater. Swim up close so that you can use the bubbles.

7918.text1: If I wasn't stuck here day in and day out, I would have attained the mastery required to train the likes of you! Unfortunately that's not the case. Go talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

7919.text1: Hmm, you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. If you do what I ask, and do it well, maybe we can discuss your training.

7949.text: I already know a lot about style. Now it's just a matter of mastering the techniques for working with leather. Good thing Simon's a real sport about helping me learn them.

7962.text1: I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.

7964.text1: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

7974.text: Your talent is beyond my own, friend. Speak with Tarn here; his knowledge of leather is much greater than mine. I'm sure he would welcome another student.

7987.text: Even I have my limitations! Go talk to Lavinia Crowe in Undercity if you wish to further your training.

7988.text: Not bad... I suppose training you is not out of the question. Very well! Let's begin...

7989.text: Randal's a bit of a dandy, but he's dependable, which is more than I can say for a lot of the students I take on. Still, I guess I can't blame them for wanting a bit of adventure.

7993.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

8020.text: You won't learn anything new from me; you know too much already. If you want more training, talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Send her my regards, eh?

8050.text1: Cairne has brought us to a land rich with possibilities for the future. We have been fortunate, and so in turn we pass on our good fortune to others. That is why I began teaching, $n.

8058.text1: You have wasted your time and mine by coming to me for training, $n. I have no time to teach basic skills. We're fighting a war here, and this is one of the front lines. Don't return to me until you are more prepared.

8078.text: I am knowledgable, but I am not an expert. You know who you should talk to? Rhiannon! She's not far. Ask around for her in Undercity

8079.text: So... you want to be a tailor? Very well, we'll see if you have what it takes.

8081.text: I'm just a student myself, really. Rhiannon's the expert. She's standing by the crates over there. You can learn a lot from her.

8094.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

8095.text: How may I be of service?

8096.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

8111.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

8116.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

8122.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

8182.text1: Good, you've got some grit! I like that. Well then, let's get going!

8264.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.
8264.text1: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

8389.text: Greetings, $c. Is there something I can help you with?

8390.text: My question to you is this, $c:$BWhich of the Aspects created by the titans became the nefarious creature known as Deathwing?

8391.text: It's always nice when someone wishes to speak to me. How are things with you, $c?

8392.text: Now, answer me this, $n:$BWhich creature became the Lich King before spreading the plague across Lordaeron?

8402.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.
8402.text1: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

8406.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?
8406.text1: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

9017.text: Master Nesingwary has a big hunt ahead of him.  I find helping him prepare for a day in the jungle is much more relaxing than helping him ready for combat.  Although I do miss some of those glorious moments on the battlefield.

9556.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.
9556.text1: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

9557.text: I can teach you fishing skills.
9557.text1: I can teach you fishing skills.

9686.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.
9686.text1: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

9687.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.
9687.text1: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

9688.text: I can teach you how to cook!
9688.text1: I can teach you how to cook!

9780.text: If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!$B$BGrimand Elmore, at your service!

9891.text: Hail $g brother : sister;... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.$B$BWe tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

10028.text: Welcome!  Welcome to Yebb Neblegear's Darkmoon Zoo Bizarre - a Trove of Living Legends and Mythical Oddities!  Enjoy your visit, friend!$B$BBut be mindful of what you touch!  These exhibits hold artifacts and beasts both dire and divine!  They might burn the wayward hand of an over-curious onlooker...

10029.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10031.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10032.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $n.

10037.text: Step right up, step right up! If you have tickets from the Darkmoon Faire you'd like redeemed, then just say so! You can redeem tickets in various denominations for wondrous and fantastic prizes. Don't be shy, give it a try!

10046.text: I have long known you'd seek me out, $n.$B$BEvery sentient being in this world is driven by the choices they make.  Choices begat further choices, and these in turn make someone who they are.  This is where your fortune is drawn from - who you are, and the choices you make.$B$BAre you ready to discover where your fortune lies?

10048.text: Very well then...$B$BYou have been tasked by your liege to guard his fields of corn from poachers and thieves.  One night on patrol, you stumble across a haggard man in thread-bare clothing stealing corn from the field.  You quickly confront him, and he immediately begs for his life.  He claims he is stealing the corn to feed his family since the lord of the land - your liege - demands too much in taxes.  Your liege is indeed known for his harsh taxes throughout the land.$B$BMake your choice.

10053.text: Your next choice awaits.$B$BYou are the sworn executioner for your liege.  A man has been sent to you for execution as a traitor of the liege and your people.  You know this individual as a close, virtuous friend who mysteriously vanished one day.  You also know that the man's crimes for which he was convicted supposedly caused the deaths of many innocent civilians.  Upon seeing you he begs for his life, claiming he was framed by a higher authority.$B$BMake your choice.

10090.text: Your fortune is cast, $c.  For the next few hours, you will find your spirit in tune with your true nature.  Be careful, as your fortune - and your fate - are never as clear as you might think them to be.$B$BIf you would like a small glimpse of something to ponder in your future, by all means let me know.  I'd be happy to give you a written fortune, provided you have room in your inventory.  It is one drawn from the insight you have shown in answering my questions.

10092.text: Here is your fortune, $n.  May it serve you well.

10123.text1: Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire, $c!$B$BMy name is Kerri Hicks and I'd shake your hand but I'm afraid I'd break it, because I'm the strongest woman alive!

10133.text: Step right up!  Get your Red Hot Wings right here!

10162.text: Greetings.  I am Chronos - He Who Never Forgets.  My memory is without flaw, and exact to the most minor detail.$B$BTrust me.

10164.text: Hello!  And welcome!  I'm afraid my booth is not open... many repairs are needed...$B$BBut I am still bound by blood oath to put a smile on your face.  So please, smile, or I must cut off my hand and consume no living flesh until it regenerates...

10175.text1: Tasty drinks for sale!  Quench your thirst on some of the Darkmoon Faire's finest brews!

10753.text: Where would you like to fly to?
10753.text1: Where would you like to fly to?

10863.text: War is upon us, $n.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

11865.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

212747.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.
212747.text1: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, ma'am. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

250597.text1: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

252022.text:
Now that I've seen this land and have heard the sound of the earth here, I think I am glad I made the journey. 

Ah, forgive me. I am thinking aloud. I am called Stonetorch, and I come here seeking knowledge of a brilliant white stone that some say fell from the sky and came to rest in the hills over yonder. Some among my people believe that this is a tear wept from An'she, the eye of the Earth Mother herself.

I don't know if I believe that, but I do intend to see this phenomenon for myself and make my own judgement.
252022.text1:
Now that I've seen this land and have heard the sound of the earth here, I think I am glad I made the journey. 

Ah, forgive me. I am thinking aloud. I am called Stonetorch, and I come here seeking knowledge of a brilliant white stone that some say fell from the sky and came to rest in the hills over yonder. Some among my people believe that this is a tear wept from An'she, the eye of the Earth Mother herself.

I don't know if I believe that, but I do intend to see this phenomenon for myself and make my own judgement.

255583.text: I can't chat for long, $c. My subjects require constant observation.

290402.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.
290402.text1: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

292961.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

299683.text: Hail and well met, traveler.$B$BI wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

299703.text:
Unfortunately, the rumor of our plight is true. Disruptions to our leylines have unveiled a disturbance amongst the arcane forces of our city.

With Dalaran on the cusp of reopening its borders to our allies, we are in dire need of immediate solutions.

300665.text1: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

301834.text: There won't be an explosion. The detonator I gave you was designed to fail.

301836.text: SI:7 will take things from here. The forge and warship you liberated from the Defias have strategic value and we are taking control of them.

301837.text1: You don't understand. That forge is poisoning the farms of Westfall! If it isn't destroyed, nothing will grow here for generations. You're risking a major famine!

301838.text: Thank you for your concern, elf, but this is now a Stormwind internal matter. Your help is no longer needed at this time.

301857.text1:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

302214.text:
The full story requires time that I suspect you do not have, so I will attempt to be brief.

Perhaps the simplest way I can put it: these crystals are anchors. They can be used to permanently--well, so long as the crystals hold I suppose--bind something, someone, or even somewhere onto our plane of Azeroth. Prince Tortheldrin ordered the creation of similar pylons when he chose to bind the demon Immol'thar. Some of the Shen'dralar protested this decision and proposed a compelling alternative, but ultimately the prince was uninterested in debate and eager to silence dissent.

I had an opportunity to study their design before it became too unsafe for me to stay within the city's walls and I fled back to Shen'dralas.

302215.text:
The proposed alternative to demonic entanglement was at odds with what Tortheldrin had already set in motion. Given that he was working with power that tends to cloud one's judgment, it's no surprise that his first instinct was to lash out.

Most everyone who pushed back against his plans to summon and bind a demon were slain that day. Some escaped, including some of my own kin that stood in opposition to the prince, but I have yet to meet other survivors of that schism even after all these thousands of years.

302815.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.

304595.text1: As experienced as one might be, I urge you to travel with caution. These plains are home to ferocious beasts and others who seek to remove us from these lands. Even the skies have become too dangerous for our wyverns.

305021.text: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.

307136.text:
This was once a part of Eldre'Thalas - the ancient city of my people that lies just over the southern mountains. Dire Maul, I believe it is commonly called these days. Perhaps you have heard of it.

Over time, the elements have worn away at our marvelous structures and smothered our gardens. I yearn to return to the halls of Eldre'Thalas, but I am still haunted by memories of the past.

For now, I am content merely watching over these lands and reminiscing over what once was.

307829.text: Greetings, hunter. I can teach you skills and techniques.
307829.text1: Greetings, hunter. I can teach you skills and techniques.

309779.text:
No fights goin' on today, pal. The Horde and the Alliance are too busy killin' each other out in the fields when there's perfectly good coin to be made doin' that in my arena! Go figure.

Come back when I get this place up and runnin'.

309855.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

309858.text: You won't find better equipment anywhere else!

310771.text: They are going to see somethin' really scary!

311861.text: What can these old bones do for you, $c? Perhaps you would like to hear of a troll legend?

313610.text:
I'm inclined to agree. Despite our people coming together to survive the Great Sundering it seems as though the city was nonetheless doomed. How pedantic is it that its fall from grace would come from something so mundane as internal strife?

My loyalty was unquestionable in those days, but in the years since I've come to realize that the rebellion was the moment that we truly lost Prince Tortheldrin. Everything that came after is but a consequence of that wound upon his soul.
 
For my part, I try to avoid dwelling on the past, particularly my role in those events.

Try as I might though... it still haunts me.

313613.text:
Celebrating my own life as I stare toward the mass grave of so many of my kin feels... selfish. Many among my order remain cloistered in Prince Tortheldrin's inner sanctum, I suspect to hide from their own guilt. Seeing the city from this perspective makes it difficult to avoid painful truths.

I still count myself among the Shen'dralar, but these days I am long estranged from the library I once called home.

327773.text:
<As you near this saber, it growls menacingly. Its long tail lashes behind it.

It bares its teeth while digging its nails into the soft earth. It would seem its temperament is as stormy as its namesake.

It gently sniffs the air around you, then after a moment, huffs. It seems impressed when you stand your ground.

It seems this saber senses your determination and approves. It will accept you as a worthy rider and champion, should you choose it.>

327777.text1: <The great cat stretches its long, nimble legs as you approach, making no sound with the motion.>

327778.text1:
<The great cat stretches its long, nimble legs as you approach, making no sound with the motion.

It shakes its head, the armor on its body fitting it snugly so as to also be completely silent with its movements.

It watches you closely, as it flexes its sharp claws. This silent saber eyes you and sniffs the air around you.

In a slight bow it inclines its head toward you, impressed with all you have accomplished. It seems to have found you a worthy champion and rider should you choose it.>

327780.text1:
<As you approach, the saber turns its great head to regard you.

Through the glowing visor of its helm, you can feel its piercing eyes evaluating you. It stands stock-still, the rustling of its fur in the gentle Teldrassil wind being the only movement. It almost seems as if it can sense how you have grown, and all the adventures and trials you have overcome.

After a long moment, it lets out a low growl and inclines its armored head.

It would appear this saber has accepted you as both a stalwart champion and confident rider should you choose it.>

327783.text:

H4z4rd Flashdasher 3X 4000. Now with new radiation sensors, and decontamination misters!>

327788.text:
<As you walk up to this ram, it watches you with interest before lowering its head and pointing its horns at you. It gazes steadily at you for a long moment with a challenging snort, then relaxes as recognition flickers in its eyes.

It snorts and shakes the snow from its armored head; its thick ram horns gleam with new nicks and dents from all of the battles it has fought and won since you last met.

This fierce ram seems to sense your determination and approves. It will accept you as its rider and champion.>

327796.text: <The raptor turns to fix you with two vibrant orange eyes.>

327804.text: <Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you.>
327804.text1:
<The wolf turns its head to regard you as you draw near. Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you. It sniffs you gently, and after a moment lets out a low but not unfriendly growl in recognition. 

 
It stands up straighter, seemingly to show off the heavy armor adorning its body. The freshly polished metal gleams, even under a coat of Durotar dust kicked up by the hot winds. 

Something within you stirs and you sense that this wolf approves of your bravery and would be proud to bear you as its friend and rider.>

327805.text: <As you approach this wolf it shakes its great head; its armor glints gently against its ashen fur.>

327806.text: <The wolf stands tall and strong, even with the added weight of the armor.>
327806.text1:
<Just as the freshly hewed timbers of a cedar tree fade from red to grey, so too has this timber wolf's fur changed with maturity. Its once boisterous personality is focused, and it stands tall and strong, even with the added weight of the armor. 
 
Its long tail still wags in familiarity as you approach and lets out a knowing whine. Through the glowing enchantment of the helmet's visor, you see its eyes shine with determination; its thirst for adventure is undiminished. 

After a moment it lets out an excited growl. You get the sense that this wolf admires your adventurous spirit and is impressed by all the challenges you have surmounted. It would gladly accept you as a rider and companion.>

329728.text: <The Wild God lying motionless before you is transparent and incorporeal, as if he is simply... fading away. He shifts slightly as you approach, its glassy eyes following your movement weakly.>

329730.text: Step back, mortal. I will channel magic so that you may see what I saw...

329731.text: No, Ve'han! Do not do this! You are betraying your oath as a protector of the mountain!

329732.text: Oaths are meaningless if those we serve betray us! Know this before you die, lesser god. Our Pact is strong. We will reclaim what was stolen from us!

329734.text: Yes... I can feel it. The power! I can feel the ancient power returning. I am... invincible!

329735.text: I have never seen magic such as this. He absorbed that demigod's power. Invincible indeed...

329736.text: Even a lesser Wild God contains a font of immense energy. No mortal should have this power.

329737.text: Return to Starblaze and tell him what you've learned, little mortal.

329738.text1: As soon as I recover I will take flight for the summit. If I am able, I will find out what became of the other Wild Gods there. Be well, $n.

329786.text1:
<Jereman fall silent for a long moment bows her head.>  

Velician. She was one of the few on this mountain that was a constant voice of reason. One that always sought to find answers when questions arose. I suspect she caught on to the cult long before any of us and went to investigate herself. Which is probably what ultimately led to her demise. 

I... do not know if her spirit will be in the Dream. I do not know what happens to those once their power is taken. I hope she heals and is able to remanifest herself as the rest of us do when we die.
